name: Passaic River Water Watch
rail_water: Lower Passaic, tidal, below the Dundee Dam
station_note: The coordinate is published to two decimal places on purpose. One person stands in the same spot at the same hour every week.
bands_note: Each band carries a word and a texture as well as a color, so the call survives a photocopier and a color blind reader.

band_say.green: Normal precautions. Wash your hands after handling lines and blades.
band_say.yellow: Elevated. Keep hands away from your face on the water, and wash before you eat.
band_say.red: Above the single sample line. No swimming and no intentional contact. Rinse and wash after the row.
